architecture_findings.title: 28-Slot Sport Router & Sitemap Inventory
architecture_findings.detail: OLBG routes sports under /betting-tips/{Sport_Slug}/{Sport_ID} across integer slots 1..28. Sitemap /sitemap-betting-tips.xml exposes 24 active sport IDs (16 clearly in-scope + 1 scope-ambiguous Gaelic Football ID 25 + 7 excluded IDs {1,2,6,11,16,17,26}). Slots {18,19,24,27} and 29+ return 'No tips found.' (leaving Badminton and Table Tennis without active OLBG hubs despite ongoing BWF French Open and WTT events).

architecture_findings.title: Canonical ISO-8601 UTC vs Unlabeled Edge-IP Local Clock
architecture_findings.detail: Every SSR fixture card emits <time itemprop='startDate' datetime='YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00.000Z'> in exact UTC, while visible innerText renders in the requesting edge node's local timezone without a timezone token ('Tomorrow 02:40' BST UTC+1 on UK captures vs 'Today 21:40' EDT UTC-4 on US-East page reads). Scraping innerText produced 28+ cross-build date discrepancies in data/master.json.

architecture_findings.title: Client-Hydrated <span class='ui-odds'> Empty SSR InnerText
architecture_findings.detail: SSR HTML stores all three price formats inside attributes () with empty text content until client JS hydration. Markdown/text readers therefore see 'WIN @' without prices unless raw HTML data-* attributes are extracted.

architecture_findings.title: Strict Region/Competition Path Coupling on ?event_id= Multi-Market Pages
architecture_findings.detail: Deep-linking to ?event_id={id} requires either the exact 3-segment {Region}/{Competition}/{Event_Slug}/{Sport_ID} path (e.g., /Basketball/NBA/NBA/DEN_Nuggets_@_OKC_Thunder/4?event_id=534843) or /All_{Sport}/All_Events/{Event_Slug}/{Sport_ID}?event_id={id}; mismatched slugs return 'No tips found.'. Validated event pages expose Set Betting, 1st Set, Handicap Games/Frames/Legs/Points, Total O/U, and Correct Score markets.

architecture_findings.title: Tipster Consensus Concentration Below -250 American (1.40 Decimal)
architecture_findings.detail: Because OLBG's tipster leaderboard rewards strike rate alongside LSP, high-consensus (>70%) featured picks cluster heavily on sub--250 moneylines (41 upcoming OLBG featured picks sit shorter than 1.40 decimal / -250 American, down to Provence Rugby at 1.01 / -10000 and Stormers at 1.03 / -3333). Originating spread/handicap/total lines unlocks high-conviction selections inside the -250 to +10000 window.
